events.what_it_is: A free interactive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with photo moments, games, a claw machine and scratch-off prizes.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples; games offer chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise. No purchase is necessary for the promotion.
events.caveats: Official sources describe the activation as free and say visitors can stop by; no advance RSVP requirement is published. Treats and on-site game pieces/prizes are while supplies last. Normal capacity may still apply.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 17-19 from 12-6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. The official promotion rules say no purchase is necessary and on-site game pieces remain available through Sept. 19 at 6 PM or while supplies last, whichever comes first.

events.event_name: Karol G — Viajando Por El Mundo Pop-Up
events.address: High Line Nine Gallery, 507 West 27th Street, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A two-day immersive Karol G experience inspired by the song Viajando Por El Mundo, with destination-themed installations, passport-style stamps, photo moments and a Cash App-powered merchandise storefront.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the immersive experience is advertised; merchandise is for purchase. Cash App Card holders receive a 20% merchandise discount.
events.caveats: Current coverage explicitly says the pop-up is open to the public. No advance RSVP or ticket requirement was identified in the verified sources. Merchandise costs extra; some perks require a Cash App Card. Normal venue capacity may apply.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 17-18, 11 AM-6 PM both days, at High Line Nine Gallery, 507 W 27th St. The Sept. 17 occurrence is already over as of this verification pass; Sept. 18 remains actionable.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum × Macy’s Herald Square Pop-Up
events.address: Macy’s Herald Square Plaza, 151 West 34th Street, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: An open-air launch pop-up for Max Mara Le Parfum outside Macy’s Herald Square, with an interactive scent experience, photo moments, games and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato, fragrance samples and chances to win giveaways are advertised, while supplies last.
events.caveats: The organizer's Eventbrite page confirms the event, date, hours and location, while the event description does not establish whether an Eventbrite ticket is required for ordinary admission. Patch says to 'stop by.' Preserve ACCESS UNCLEAR rather than claiming Free RSVP or Walk-In without stronger admission wording. Samples, gelato and giveaways are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM-6 PM at Macy’s Herald Square Plaza, 151 W 34th St. The Eventbrite listing is organized by Max Mara and can be used as the actionable event page.
